import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "JACC") || Pkg.add(name = "JACC", version = "1")
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "Atomix") || Pkg.add("Atomix")
using CUDA
import JACC
import Atomix
JACC.@init_backend
using LinearAlgebra
using JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function jacc_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_1!(__jacc_i, loss, __jgen_redval)
    Atomix.@atomic loss[1] += __jgen_redval[1]
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_2!(__jacc_i, i_n, loss, u, v)
    i_x = 1 + (__jacc_i - 1)
    Atomix.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_3!(__jacc_i, i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    i_x = i_n + (__jacc_i - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_atom(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    if div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 < 9223372036854775807
        if div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 > 0
            JACC.@parallel_for range = div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 jacc_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, loss, u, v)
        end
    else
        __jgen_atom_redval_1 = JACC.@parallel_reduce(range = div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, (((i_x, u, v)->u[i_x] * v[i_x]))(u, v))
        JACC.@parallel_for range = 1 jacc_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_1!(loss, __jgen_atom_redval_1)
    end
    if div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1 > 0
        JACC.@parallel_for range = div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1 jacc_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_3!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    end
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_red_dotprod_b_1!(__jacc_i, loss, __jgen_redval)
    Atomix.@atomic loss[1] += __jgen_redval[1]
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_red_dotprod_b_2!(__jacc_i, i_n, loss, u, v)
    i_x = 1 + (__jacc_i - 1)
    Atomix.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_red_dotprod_b_3!(__jacc_i, i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    i_x = i_n + (__jacc_i - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_red(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    if div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 < 0
        if div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 > 0
            JACC.@parallel_for range = div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 jacc_kernel_red_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, loss, u, v)
        end
    else
        __jgen_red_redval_1 = JACC.@parallel_reduce(range = div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, (((i_x, u, v)->u[i_x] * v[i_x]))(u, v))
        JACC.@parallel_for range = 1 jacc_kernel_red_dotprod_b_1!(loss, __jgen_red_redval_1)
    end
    if div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1 > 0
        JACC.@parallel_for range = div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1 jacc_kernel_red_dotprod_b_3!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    end
    return nothing
end



function bench(f, a, reps)
    for _ in 1:20; f(a...); end; JACC.synchronize()
    best = Inf
    for _ in 1:5
        t0 = time(); for _ in 1:reps; f(a...); end; JACC.synchronize()
        best = min(best, (time() - t0) / reps * 1e6)
    end
    return best
end
function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
    try r["jacc_array"] = string(JACC.array_type()) catch e; r["jacc_array"] = "?" end
    tbl = Dict{String,Any}()
    for n in (256, 1024, 4096, 16384, 65536, 262144)
        u = JACC.array(rand(n)); v = JACC.array(rand(n))
        ub = JACC.zeros(Float64, n); vb = JACC.zeros(Float64, n)
        loss = JACC.zeros(Float64, 1); lossb = JACC.ones(Float64, 1)
        a = (loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, n)
        reps = n > 100000 ? 100 : 300
        ta = bench(dotprod_atom, a, reps); tr = bench(dotprod_red, a, reps)
        tbl["n$(n)"] = Dict("atomic_us" => round(ta, digits=2),
                            "reduce_us" => round(tr, digits=2),
                            "speedup" => round(ta/tr, digits=3))
    end
    r["dotprod"] = tbl
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
